name: Filled Cursed Ooze Jar
summary: In Felwood, a Filled Cursed Ooze Jar holds a sample for Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge. The gnome scholar seeks the ancient origins of slimes across Azeroth.

sections.title: A Curious Specimen
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle, a gnome researcher, sees mystery where most adventurers see vile puddles and caustic slimes. Slimes thrive in many places, and Forsaken apothecaries gather them with care. Those sights led Geardawdle to a bold theory: oozes may be primordial secretions bound to Azeroth's creation. To gather a sample, brave Felwood's blighted woods, defeat a cursed ooze, and scoop its acidic remains into an empty jar before they dissolve.

sections.title: Academic Ambition
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle hopes his ooze samples will bring both knowledge and a lasting name. A major discovery could secure his reputation in the dwarven-led Explorers' League. Since Gnomeregan fell, many gnome refugees in Ironforge feel pressed to prove their worth to their dwarven hosts. Geardawdle believes that uncovering the ancient secrets of ooze will show them that welcoming gnomes was no mistake.

faq.q: Where does this jar come from?
aliases: where do i get cursed ooze jar
how to get filled cursed ooze jar
faq.answer: Use an Empty Cursed Ooze Jar on the remains of a defeated Cursed Ooze in Felwood's corrupted lands to fill it.
Laris Geardawdle, a gnome researcher in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, wants the samples for his natural history research.

faq.q: Why is Laris Geardawdle studying oozes?
faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle studies oozes because he sees nature and the Royal Apothecary Society taking interest in them. He suspects slimes may be ancient secretions tied to life's creation and development on Azeroth, and needs samples to test his theory.

faq.q: Why does a gnome care about the Explorers' League?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan fell, gnome refugees found shelter among the dwarves in Ironforge. Laris Geardawdle hopes a major discovery through the Explorers' League will prove that sheltering them was the right choice.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see why Laris Geardawdle cares so deeply about slime research. He hopes to honor displaced gnomes and prove their intellectual worth to their dwarven hosts in Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you can see natural philosophers in Ironforge watching Forsaken movements. The Royal Apothecary Society has also shown a dark interest in gathering ooze samples across Azeroth.
